Name: S Rank Sentinel
Author: MTitan
Punchline: Standalone S-rank travel, parking, tagging, and recovery.
Description: Consumes Faloop with optional HuntAlerts/Sonar fallbacks, maps stored POIs directly to local vnavmesh destinations without relying on a game map flag, retries missing entities/routes without false-clearing, requires positive kill evidence, parks dynamically, performs one gated ranged tag, watches SS chains safely, and resets to Ul'dah on the visited World.
